references.title: IFPMA — Code of Practice for the pharmaceutical industry

title: Medical Representative Performance Analyzer
short: Helps managers coach medical representatives with fair, context-aware insight into call quality, coverage and outcomes.
symptom: Rep performance is judged on sales alone
ingredient: A coaching assistant for field force managers
directions: Connect CRM call records, territory potential and sales. Managers get coaching insights per representative, with territory context.
problem: Representatives are often evaluated on raw sales, which depends heavily on territory potential, tenders and stock — not only on their work quality.
why: Unfair evaluation demotivates good representatives and hides real coaching needs.
solution: Adjusts results for territory potential, analyses call frequency, coverage of target prescribers and message consistency with approved material, and suggests specific coaching points rather than rankings alone.
data: CRM visit records and target lists
limitations: Employee data must be handled lawfully and transparently
Must not be used as automated disciplinary decision-making
review: Managers use insights for coaching conversations; all personnel decisions remain human and follow HR policy.
